title: The Rev. Canon George Edward Jelf
dates: (29 Jan1834 -19 Nov 1908)
---

Vicar of Saffron Walden

He married (1861) Fanny Crawley (d. 1865); three of their four children died in 1871.

He married secondly (20 Jan 1876), Katharine Frances Dalton, and had four more children.

He was a canon of Rochester in 1880 and of St.

Albans in 1878, master of the Charterhouse in 1907.

He was son of R. W.

Jelf, principal of KCL 1844-69 and a friend of Keble and Pusey.

His first wife’s biography is in G.E.Jelf A Memoir.
